In Preponderance of the Small, the central situation is small matters carrying unusual consequence, and the commentarial evidence repeatedly emphasizes small, inwardly, and predominance. The main danger is ambition exceeding the scale the moment supports, especially when partial conditions are mistaken for permission to press ahead. Its constructive capacity is careful attention, modest action, and exact proportion, expressed through attention to sequence, relation, and the limits of the present position. Transformation comes through responsive timing: capacity remains available because it is neither suppressed nor spent against the grain.
